title: Markdown in Quiet.md
p: Quiet.md reads and writes Markdown as it is: a .md file stays a .md file, in your documents folder or anywhere on your computer, and other Markdown editors keep working with it. For a real file to try, open {{doc:md-example}} in this folder.

Every .md file in your documents folder shows in the sidebar as a document. To make a new one, choose Markdown from the New menu of a folder. In Settings, Quick new (⌘ N) can make Markdown what ⌘ N creates.

Choose Open Markdown File in the File menu, or press ⌘ O. In the Finder, use Open With › Quiet.md. The file opens in a window of its own and is edited where it is: nothing is copied into your documents folder, and the sidebar keeps to your folders.

ul.li: Markdown only: a Markdown page offers what Markdown can hold. Colors, alignment, callouts, columns, equations, buttons, reminders, countdowns, icons and covers are left out of its menus.
Your formatting stays: saving rewrites only the blocks you changed. Other lines, blank lines and front matter are kept exactly as they were.
Images beside the file: an image you paste or insert is copied into a folder named after the file, such as Plan.assets, and linked with a relative path.
The title is the filename: renaming the page renames the file.
Changed elsewhere: if another app saves the file while it is open, Quiet.md does not overwrite it.

p: The entry's More menu can import a copy into your documents folder, show the file in the Finder, or remove it from the list. Removing it never deletes the file.
h1: What a Markdown page can hold
p: Markdown itself has headings, paragraphs, emphasis, lists, quotes, code, links and images. Quiet.md also reads and writes the widely used extensions and conventions, and says which is which:

td.p: Headings, lists, quotes, code blocks, links, images, bold and italic
GFM, the extensions GitHub made common
A convention: a YAML block between --- lines at the top. Quiet.md keeps it exactly as it was and does not show it on the page.

A convention: a code block whose language is mermaid. Quiet.md draws it as a diagram, as GitHub and Obsidian do; in the file it is still a standard code block, and an editor that does not draw Mermaid shows the code.

p: In every page, Markdown or not, these markers format as you type. At the start of a line, type the marker followed by a space unless noted otherwise.

td.p: Code block; Space or Enter completes it
Divider, as soon as you type the third dash
Text styles, applied when you type the closing marker

p: With a Chinese input method you do not have to switch to half-width: ＃, －, ＋, ＊, ＞, 》, ｜ and 1． or 1。 work like their ASCII twins, —— makes a bulleted list, 【】 a task, ··· or ｀｀｀ a code block, and 、 on an empty line opens the slash menu.
Press ⌘ Z right after a conversion to keep the characters you typed.
Any document can be exported as Markdown: open its More menu, or right-click its sidebar entry, and choose a download format.

column.p: Export a single Markdown file without copying images or attachments.
Export the Markdown file alongside an assets folder. Image and attachment links use relative paths.

p: Some rich layouts have no exact Markdown equivalent:

td.p: Blockquotes beginning with the callout icon
Pipe-separated tables; multiple cell paragraphs use line breaks
Content written in sequence rather than side by side
Not all styling is representable; use PDF when appearance matters
